# Bioinformatic Data Science Lab

We aim to address biology questions through computational approach, i.e., design
algorithm for sequence alignment/phylogenetic reconstruction, explore machine
learning in protein function prediction, apply data science on cancer genomics.
:::
:::

## Research

::: {.card-grid}
::: {}
**[3D Genome Organization](research.html#3d-genome)**

Hi-C and Micro-C analysis of TADs, chromatin loops and compartments
:::
::: {}
**[Sequence Alignment & Phylogenetics](research.html#alignment-phylogenetics)**

Alignment reliability, bootstrap support and evolutionary modeling
:::
::: {}
**[Single-Cell Data Analysis](research.html#single-cell)**

Hierarchical clustering and visualization of single-cell data
:::
::: {}
**[Protein Function Prediction](research.html#protein-function)**

Subcellular localization and Gene Ontology prediction from sequence
:::
:::

## Getting in Touch

- If you are interested in visiting/joining our group, please contact Jia-Ming Chang.
- 如果你是碩博士班的學生，對如何應用資料科學方法在生物資訊課題感興趣，歡迎[來信](mailto:chang.jiaming@gmail.com)或帶著你的想法， 來辦公室一起討論。
- 如果你是大學生，想體驗何謂生物資訊，歡迎[來信](mailto:chang.jiaming@gmail.com)告知之前的經驗、修過哪些相關課程和可投入研究的時間。本研究室全力支持你邁向科學研究之路。
